guardrails: The original first-party URL equality is direct corroboration of a source relationship, not permission to rewrite historical provenance or automatically merge CL2 sites.
An institution's owner-reported Mass time must not be imported into CL27 schedules without separate current-site and rite validation.
Same postal address and same monastery strongly indicate one physical-site identity; FSSP ministry and convent owner fields must remain distinct before dedup.
The LMD 'new' status is a change in LMD listings, NOT proof of a new physical church.
The eight recent LMD Poland additions are not eight proven missing CL2 sites; at least one is already present under an abbreviated title.
Do not suppress any Ad Orientem-only site based on LMD omission or canceled status.
All cases remain research-only; use CL2 Excel approval for any proposed new group or merge.
